text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Subaru and his friends were enjoying the summer sea when suddenly, a giant white whale appeared in front of them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏の海を楽しもうとしていたスバルたち。
そんな彼らの前に突如、巨大な白い鯨が姿を現した。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Is that...?
text_block_list.orig_text: あれは……？

text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: A giant...demonic beast...! What is that appearance!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
巨大な……
魔獣……！
あの姿は！？

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: I never thought I'd see that beast in this world. That's a Gluttony...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか
この世界で見るとは思わなかったよ。
暴食の──

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Why would this thing even be here...?! Emilia, stay away from that thing! That's the White Wh.... ( TLNote: ReZero reference, a main villain )
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで、あいつが……！
エ
ミリア、
絶対に近付くな！
あいつは白鯨──

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...It's a white whale!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──シロクジラです！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...A white... wha...le?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……シロ
クジ
ラ？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: That is indeed a white whale.
text_block_list.orig_text: シロクジラでございます。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Uh, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
でも……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That's a white whale.
text_block_list.orig_text: シロクジラよ。

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia and the others
text_block_list.text: A white whale...
text_block_list.orig_text: シロクジラ……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Heyas☆! It's been a while, Emilia and the others! Are you taking a vacation on the beach today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいっすー☆
お久しぶりです、
エミリアちゃんたち！
今日は海でバカンスですかっ？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Wah, Pecorine! "Vacation"... Um, we're here today due to Subaru's idea, "Summah Vacashiun...?" Something like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
ペコリーヌ！
ばかんす……
えっと、
今日はスバルの発案で、
『さまぁばけぇしょん』？　
なんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: ...Lady Kyaru! This one seems to be a big shot, so watch your distance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──キャルさま！
相手は大物、
間合いにお気を付けくださいませ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Wow, a summer vacation sure sounds nice♪ It makes me happy to know that even guests from another world are enjoying this world☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁっ、
サマーバケーション
いいですね♪
異世界からのお客さんが
この世界を楽しんでくれてるのって、
なんだかわたしまでうれしくなっちゃいます☆

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I find you as energetic as ever, Pecorine. Um, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ペコリーヌは相変わらずすごーく元気みたい。
えっと、
それで……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Korosuke! That thing's trying to move from there! Watch out for that long tail!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロ助！
コイツ体勢を変えようとしてるわよ！
長い尾に気を付けなさい！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know, Emilia! There's a restaurant around here where you can eat delicious seafood♪ I'll tell you where it is, so be sure to give it a try!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだエミリアちゃん！
この辺りには
美味しい海鮮料理を食べられるお店があるんですよ♪
場所を教えますので、
是非食べてみてくださいね！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Wow, that sounds really nice. Thank you so much. But, um, Pecorine...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
そうなのね。
すごーくありがと。
でも、あのね、ペコリーヌ……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Um, about that... Are you sure they're fine?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その……
あっちはいいのかしら？

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Pecorine! How long are you going to keep chatting away?! We're in the middle of a battle here! And a boss battle at that! You're pretty brave to just casually go and say hello in the middle of this...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとペコリーヌ！　
いつまでくっちゃべってんのよ！
こっちは戦闘中なんだけど！？　
しかもボス戦！
あんたよくさらっと挨拶に行けたわね！？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Pecorine! I know how you must feel, I also wish to greet Lady Emilia properly...! And we have to introduce her not only to local restaurants, but also tourist spots and lots of other things...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ペコリーヌさま！
わたくしも
エミリアさまにご挨拶を……！
それと
お食事のお店だけではなく、
観光地などもご紹介しなくては……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Et tu, Korosuke?! Is it just me? Am I the only one taking this fight seriously?! Fine then! I'll do this myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロ助あんたまで！？
あたしだけ？　
真面目に戦ってるのあたしだけ！？
上等よ
やってやろうじゃない！

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I CAN'T DO IT AFTER AAAALLLLLL!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: やっぱ無理ーーーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Good grief. You've become sloppy in the short time since I last saw you, Kyaru. Rem, please help her out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ、
少し見ない間にだらしなくなったものねキャル。
レム、
手助けしてあげなさい。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: At once, Sister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
姉様！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you... Wait, you're not the one who saved me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ありがと……
って、
あんたが助けなさいよ！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Hah! What nerve do you have to complain after being saved? You should be grateful to the strong and lovely Rem, and to Ram for giving her proper instructions. At once.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハッ！　
助けられて文句なんていい度胸だこと。
強くて可憐なレムと、
それを指示したラムに素直に感謝なさい。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Lady Kokkoro! Please be careful not to get caught up in this... Huma!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コッコロ様！
巻き込まれないようご注意を──
ヒューマ！

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: She froze the seawater and created an ice wall...? Lady Rem... Thank you very much. You saved me. This will do to buy us a lot of time to stall it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海水を凍らせて、氷壁を……？
レムさま……
ありがとうございます。
助かりました。
これならば
十分に足止めの時間を稼げます。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: A giant whale suddenly barged into a peaceful sea! BUT SUDDENLY, friends who we've fought together in the past appeared, huh. That's a pretty heated development!
text_block_list.orig_text:
平和な海に突如現れた巨大クジラ！
だがそこにかつて一緒に戦った仲間が現れる、
か。
なかなか熱い展開じゃねぇか！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Hey, bro. Have you been well? I can tell just by looking at you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう、
兄弟。
元気にしてたか？　
なんて見りゃ分かるけどよ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did you just forget about me? Well, I suppose last time we mostly interacted as I was covered in robes. Now that I think about it, I guess I looked like a creep huh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
もしかして俺、
忘れられてる？
まぁ、
前の時はほとんどローブで顔隠してたけどさ。
ってよく考えたら完全に不審者だな……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: It's me! Natsuki Subaru! A freakishly bound and impoverished prophet! Remember how we toasted together and swore to be blood brothers... right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺だよ俺！　
ナツキ・スバル！
合縁奇縁にして
天壌無窮の予言者！
乾杯して義兄弟の契りを交わした仲だろー？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: So the target of the delicious-eating guild, the Gourmet Guild, is that giant whale, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
美味しいものを食べつくすギルド
【美食殿】の
今回のターゲットは、
あの巨大クジラってとこか？

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: I can't even imagine how many people that thing will serve...
text_block_list.orig_text: 何人前になるのか想像もつかないね～

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: About that... It's a shame, but this time we're here for a subjugation request from the Guild Management Association.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが残念なんですけど、
今回は
ギルド管理協会からの討伐依頼なんですよ～

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That SHITTY GLASSES told us to come and investigate reports of a giant shadow being seen in the waters around here... and this is what we found! Nobody told us it'd be a whale this big!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海の近辺に現れる巨大な影の正体を調べてこいって
クソ眼鏡に言われてきてみれば、
この有様よ！
あんなでかいクジラだなんて聞いてない！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Kyaru... I recall you being so excited and saying: "I'll finish the extermination in a flash and then I'll enjoy a leisurely swim in the sea!". What a pity.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルさま……
「討伐なんてちょちょいと終わらせて
あとは優雅に海水浴するわよ！」
と
張り切っておられましたのに、
おいたわしい限りです。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, what are you even saying? How cold. It is FATE that led us to meet here. We owe you a big favor too, bro, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
何言ってんだよ水くさい。
ここで会ったのもなんかの縁ってやつだ。
兄弟たちには借りもあるし──

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Let us help with this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
手伝わせてくれよ、
俺たちにも。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Yes, you’re completely right, Subaru. Pecorine, please let us fight alongside you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
そうねスバル。
ペコリーヌ、
私たちも一緒に戦わせて。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Are you sure...? I'm sure that if Emilia and the others helped us, our strength would increase an hundredfold... But I thought you were enjoying this beautiful beach...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいんですか……？
エミリアちゃんたちが居てくれれば百人力ですけど……
みんな、せっかくの海なのに……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! With monsters like this around, neither Subaru-kun nor my Sister could relax in peace!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お任せください！
こんな魔物がいては
スバルくんも姉様も安心して楽しめません。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Our rest is already ruined anyway.
text_block_list.orig_text: せっかくの休息が台無しね。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: As for me, of course, I won't tolerate anyone who disturbs Lia's safety.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクはもちろん、
リアの安寧を脅かす輩には容赦しないよ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, everyone! Now then, let us join hands once more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます、
みなさん！
それでは再び、
手を携えましょう！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Glad to work with you again, Pecorine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
またよろしくね、
ペコリーヌ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: All right, crew! It is time to show them our power!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よぉっし野郎ども！
見せてやろうぜ、
俺たちの力を！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Rem, Rem. How strange. I wonder why Barusu, who is the least useful in battle, is so confident.
text_block_list.orig_text:
レム、レム。
不思議だわ。
戦闘で一番役に立たないバルスが
なぜあんなにも自信たっぷりなのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Sister, sister. Subaru must be trying to boost Rem and the others' morale by leading the charge with such a loud voice. Look at that fist raised to the sky, Rem's heart is trembling...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉様、姉様。
きっとスバルくんはああして大きな声で音頭をとることで、
レムたちの士気を高めてくれようとしているのです。
あの天にかざした拳をご覧ください、
レムの心は震えています……！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Can't you at least allow me to boast off a little here?! I know already, I know that I'm useless in a real fight, but still!
text_block_list.orig_text:
少しカッコつけるくらい見逃してくんない！？
そりゃ確かに
戦いじゃ役立たずもいいとこだけど！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Now, now, don’t cry just because you’re useless. Subaru, you know, personally I think you make things more lively just by being around, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあまあ、
役立たずだからって泣かない泣かない。
スバルはほら、
いるだけで賑やかでいいと思うよ？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Now I'm being treated like I'm some random beach boy, not even a fence-sitter! DAMMIT! Is it only our world's demonic beasts that give me the time of day?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
窓際社員ならぬ波打ち際の俺扱い！
クソ！　
俺に熱烈についてくるのは魔獣だけかよ！

text_block_list.name: スバル
text_block_list.text:
……いや待てよ？
この世界の魔物に通用するかはわからんが、
あれだけ白鯨に似てるんだ。
もしかしたら俺が囮として機能するかもしれねぇ……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや待てよ？
この世界の魔物に通用するかはわからんが、
あれだけ白鯨に似てるんだ。
もしかしたら俺が囮として機能するかもしれねぇ……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Well then, first, let me start by sharing information about this white whale so we...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それではまず、
あのシロクジラについての情報共有を……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'll go and be the decoy, so everyone use that opportunity I'll create...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし。
俺が囮になるから
みんなはその隙に……！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait, Subaru! You mustn’t rush out on your own...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
待ってスバル！
一人で勝手に飛び出しちゃダメ……！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I won't do anything that dangerous! All it has to do is follow my scent. Worst-case scenario, I can just taunt it to get its attention someway...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫、
そんな危ない真似はしねぇよ！
俺の臭いを追ってくれば良し。
最悪、目の前でちょろちょろして気を引ければ……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Wait a second! You should know that the white whale possesses a special power!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってください、
そのシロクジラには特殊能力が──！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm? I think I just heard something ominous like "special powers" or something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
なんか今、
特殊能力とかって不穏な単語が聞こえたような……

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's with you suddenly acting crazy... Did you just see me...? I knew it, it just had to catch a whiff or something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！？
なんだ、急に暴れやがって……
今、
俺を見た……？
やっぱり何か嗅ぎつけて──

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Barusu! What are you spacing out for?! You're in front of the enemy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
バルス！　
何をボーっとしているの！
敵の前よ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Something is coming out of the body of the white whale...! Are those... small monsters...? Subaru-kun! Please run away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シロクジラの体からなにかが出てきました……！
あれは……
小さな、魔物……？
スバルくん！　
逃げてください！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: HEY, WAIT...! IS THAT EVEN POSSIBLE?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ、まっ……！
そんなんアリ！？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: DAMMIT, I'm completely surrounded...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ、
完全に囲まれちまった……！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Bro...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 兄弟……！

text_block_list.name: Small monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Subaru!
text_block_list.orig_text: スバル！

text_block_list.name: ペコリーヌ
text_block_list.text:
{0}くん！
間に合わない……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！
間に合わない……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Subaru-kun! Subaru-kun is being swallowed by that horde of monsters...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルくんっ、
スバルくんが、
魔獣の群れに飲まれてっ……！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Please wait, Lady Rem! It's all right... They're both safe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待ちください、
レムさま！
大丈夫です……
二人とも、
無事でございます。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Puck, please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
パック、
お願い！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: I have to try and not hit Subaru and that other guy, right? I know I don't want to see my cute daughter’s sad face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルたちに当たらないよう加減して、
だね。
かわいい娘の悲しむ顔は見たくないしね。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: How about this!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ──これで、どうかなっ！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Both the white whale and those little monsters, all at once...! This fluffy thing is something else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シロクジラも、
小さいやつらもまとめて……！
大したもんねー、
このモフモフ。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Well, that's just how I roll. I think the luster on your tail is pretty good, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや～
それほどでもあるよ。
君の尻尾のツヤもなかなかのものだと思うけどね。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Did the white whale just... run away? No, more importantly, My Lord and Lord Subaru...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シロクジラは……
逃げてしまいましたか。
いえ、
今はそれよりも
主さまとスバルさまを……！

text_block_list.name: レム
text_block_list.text: スバルくんっ！
text_block_list.orig_text: スバルくんっ！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Calm down at once, Rem. External injuries... none. ...Knowing that Barusu's bad luck is strong, I wonder what that means.
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ち着きなさいレム、
外傷は……
ないわ。
……
いくらバルスの悪運が強いとはいえ、
どういうことかしら。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ah... Well, that's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー……
それは……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Ah, Subaru is about to wake up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
スバルが目を覚ましそう！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... Subaru-kun, are you all right? Your Rem is right here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
良かった……
スバルくん、
大丈夫ですか？
スバルくんのレムはここにいますよ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Subaru...?
text_block_list.orig_text: スバル……？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: BABUUUUUUUUUUUUUU---------!
text_block_list.orig_text: ばぶーーーーーーーーーーーーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...White whales. They're a mutation of the island whales that exist in this world. They have special abilities.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──シロクジラ。
あいつは
この世界にいる島クジラって魔物の突然変異でね。
特殊な能力を持っているの。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: While our common island whales feed on emotions like human desire, the white whale from earlier...
text_block_list.orig_text:
島クジラが
人の欲望などといった『感情』を味わうのに対し、
先ほどのシロクジラは──

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...They gather people's memories and "eat" them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──人の『記憶』を集め、
食べる。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: They "eat" memories...? Um, in other words...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
記憶を食べるって……
えっと、
つまり……？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: For a direct explanation, please look at My Lord.
text_block_list.orig_text: 主さまをご覧ください。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: ...And that's what happens.
text_block_list.orig_text: このようになってしまうのです。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Um... Subaru? Do you know my name...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
スバル？
私のこと、
わかる……？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: BAAAAAAAAAAA BUUUUUUUUUUUUUU!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ばーーーーーぶーーーーーーーーーーー
ーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Subaru-kun...! Your manly cry is still as impressive as ever, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルくん──！
雄々しい泣き声は依然として立派ですが……

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: This is exactly what they mean when they say "spine-chilling".
text_block_list.orig_text:
身の毛がよだつ、
とはまさにこのことね。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: I see, so this is how it ended up. Interesting~
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
こうなっちゃうんだ。
面白いね～

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Oh my, my Lord, that cry... You are hungry, aren't you? Please wait, we're about to prepare food...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや
主さま、
そのお声は……
空腹でございますね？
お待ちください、
ただいまお食事のご用意を……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ah, I have some rice balls with me. Pickled plums are dangerous because they have seeds. Here, take this salmon directly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
おにぎりあるわよ。
梅干しは種があるから危ないわよね、
じゃあ
こっちのシャケあげるわ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: It'd be dangerous if you were to swing that sword around, so let me take care of it for you♪ Instead, please hold onto this cool wooden stick that I just found on the beach♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
振り回しちゃうと危ないので、
彼の剣はわたしが預かっておきますね♪
代わりに砂浜に落ちていた
かっこいい木の棒を握っていてくださいね♪

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Pecorine. I think this time it's worse than usual...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ねえ、ペコリーヌ。
これってすごーく大変なことだと思うんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Why do you three seem so nonchalant about all this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
三人とも、
どうしてそんなにへっちゃらそうなの？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine & co.
text_block_list.text: I'm used to it☆!  I'm used to it. This is nothing new to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
「慣れてますから！」
「慣れております。」
「慣れっこなのよ。」

text_block_list.name: Emilia and the others
text_block_list.text: Eh---

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Emilia and the others were shocked to see that such a weird situation was the norm in another world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
異世界はこれが当たり前なのかと、
愕然とするエミリアたちであった。
